title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day China Box Office: Gearing Up To Record 3rd Biggest Hollywood Debut Post-COVID
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has reached an estimated $7.1M in eight-day pre-sales in China, surpassing Jurassic World: Dominion and Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire. The film ranks among the top post-COVID Hollywood pre-sales and could become the third biggest opening weekend in China, potentially guaranteeing an opening above $60M depending on word of mouth. The worldwide release is July 31.
content:
Home»Box Office

Spider-Man: Brand New Day is recording strong pre-sales numbers at the box office in China. It is gearing up to record one of the top opening weekends for Hollywood films post-COVID, and there are still three more days left to go for the pre-sales. Brand New Day has beaten Jurassic World: Dominion and Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire’s solid pre-sales collections at the box office in China.

Several fan theories have been making the rounds on the internet. Zendaya’s costume choices are making fans believe that something tragic might happen to her character. After the memory erasing spell, the fans are awaiting Peter Parker and MJ’s reunion. It is expected to be an emotional movie with a darker tone and more street‑level action, which many fans have been craving.

According to box office analyst Luiz Fernando’s report, Spider-Man: Brand New Day has beaten the entire pre-sales total of Jurassic World: Dominion at the China box office. The film completed its eighth day on Saturday with an 8-day pre-sales cume of $7.1 million for the July 28 to August 2 period. The film still has three more days left before bookings close.

The report reveals that the film has surpassed the pre-sales collections of Jurassic World: Dominion ($7.1 million) and Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire ($6 million) at China’s box office. The Tom Holland starrer has already emerged as the seventh biggest pre-sales for a Hollywood release in the post-COVID era.

Total – $7.1 million

According to the report, the film could surpass Godzilla vs. Kong’s $69.2 million as the third biggest opening weekend for Hollywood films in China in the post-pandemic era. That outcome will depend on the film’s word of mouth and audience reaction after release. The title could also become the sixth Hollywood film post-COVID to cross the $10 million mark in pre-sales alone, which would strongly indicate an opening above the $60 million mark.

Tom Holland and Zendaya’s Spider-Man: Brand New Day will release worldwide on July 31.

Note: Box office numbers are based on estimates and various sources. Numbers have not been independently verified by Koimoi.
